interpretation.retained_finding: The explicit c1 route executes and reclaims at 128K and the exact 256K model limit, removes dense KV before decode, and lowers tracked resident allocation after compact pack.
interpretation.quality_blocker: Realized long-context compression is 6.585x/7.220x rather than the CR2 calibration target. The candidate was calibrated on 768-token sequences; broad 8K/32K/128K dense-teacher quality is mandatory before promotion.
interpretation.memory_blocker: Logical shrink does not physically resize uniform max-head device buffers, leaving 2.79x/3.67x capacity-to-live slot slack. Same-host dense/no-evict controls and sampled peaks are still required for full P7 closure.
interpretation.performance_blocker: Single diagnostic timings lack a true no-DMS baseline, repetitions, profiler attribution, and equivalent quality. They support no speed claim.
